title: Does anyone know where I could find skill animations

posts.author: Salt
posts.body: I recently watched the demon slayer movie, and i was hella moved. So i wanted to start on a small project on MV regarding this show. I like the current skill animations, but they dont feel as real as i'd like them. Does anyone know where i could find skill animations in this forum or where i could buy some?

posts.author: ElvenNeko
posts.body: Somehow i very rarely saw people adding them to their tile collections, so they are hard to find on this forum. But there is also a good news - you can just google a 2d sprite sheer for effect you need, and, if author's terms are ok for you - just use the template to import those in rm, and then set the sequence you need in animation section. It is not as easy as getting complete animations, but you can config it the way you want it.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
You can find information on asset standards in Help -> Contents -> Documentation -> Asset Standardsstandards which explains how sprite sheets should be formatted.
Animations should be 192x192 cells, 5 cells wide, and as many tall as you need.
You can Google search "RPG maker mv" and one of these other search terms:
"attack animation"
"database animation"
"battle animation"
You can also find official DLC animations. You can browse the official DLC store on this website. It's easier to sort by what you are looking for here, but you don't necessarily need to buy from this website. If you are using Steam, once you find the DLC you want on RMW you can search steam for that dlc'stitle and buy.
Quintessence is a popular animation DLC. iirc the creator is Seraph Circle, who also has an itch page where more animations are available.
A word of caution: MZ changed how animations are handled so it's wise to check whether the animation is made for mv or MZ.
An additional note to that is that MZ is still capable of using the older style mv animations.
